audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Stationarity of the SAM surrogate does not imply vanishing directional curvature; The large-radius ablation confuses forgetting with utility; The released gradient penalty has no differentiation path to model parameters.
limitations: 0100-M1 — Stationarity of the SAM surrogate does not imply vanishing directional curvature — Limits: This is a generic smooth-loss counterexample to the mathematical implication. It is not a simulated LLM loss, not an NPO benchmark reproduction, and not a claim that a real unlearned model follows this trajectory.

0100-M1 — Stationarity of the SAM surrogate does not imply vanishing directional curvature — Counterevidence and limits: Eq4 explicitly linearizes the inner maximization; its closed-form optimizer of the linearized problem is correct. The audit does not misrepresent it as an exact maximizer of arbitrary nonlinear losses.

0100-M1 — Stationarity of the SAM surrogate does not imply vanishing directional curvature — Counterevidence and limits: Eq6 is explicitly a first-order Taylor approximation and Eq8 a finite-difference approximation. These local relations are retained.

0100-M1 — Stationarity of the SAM surrogate does not imply vanishing directional curvature — Counterevidence and limits: The conditional min-max formulation requires a relearning objective counteracting the forget objective and a bounded weight-perturbation threat set; it can remain a useful robust surrogate.

0100-M1 — Stationarity of the SAM surrogate does not imply vanishing directional curvature — Counterevidence and limits: AlgorithmA1 intentionally bypasses higher-order derivatives. In the scalar counterexample v is locally constant, so this bypass does not remove the counterexample.

0100-M1 — Stationarity of the SAM surrogate does not imply vanishing directional curvature — Counterevidence and limits: The analysis does not demonstrate diminished empirical UE/UT, failure of all smoothing, or ineffective unlearning. Empirical score verification is separate.

0100-M1 — Stationarity of the SAM surrogate does not imply vanishing directional curvature — Counterevidence and limits: Even a valid local directional-curvature reduction would not itself be a certificate against unrestricted fine-tuning or every attack; the paper's measured attack results remain empirical.

0100-CODE-GP — The released gradient penalty has no differentiation path to model parameters — Alternative and counterevidence: Changing printed/logged loss values is distinct from changing the optimizer's gradient. A separate unreleased implementation may have been used for the paper. The code history establishes that this expression is not a recent post-publication edit; it still does not prove run provenance.

0100-CODE-CR — The supplied curvature-regularization command has no dispatch branch; the stored class also detaches its norm — Counterevidence: The unreachable dispatch is material counterevidence against claiming that this class certainly generated the reported CR results. The paper may have used a different path or private revision. These are source-release facts, not a demonstrated failure of the reported CR score.

0100-CODE-NPO — MUSE's named NPO objective uses unnormalized full-vocabulary logits — Counterevidence: Both baseline and SAM MUSE code use the same raw-logit objective. That does not make it NPO, but it prevents inferring the sign or magnitude of bias in the SAM comparison without new evidence. The WMDP NPO path instead uses model loss differences, so the MUSE raw-logit defect must not be generalized to WMDP.

0100-EMP-BUDGET — Counterevidence: Pinned public script MUSE/baselines/run_muse_relearn.sh uses Books max_steps50/75/100, News100/125/150, per_device_batch_size4. Under one process and no other accumulation, processed-example totals match caption, but this is not an immutable publication run record or proof of distinct sample count.
0100-EMP-WA — Counterevidence: Either value is better than NPO.37 and below SAM.45; this discrepancy does not alter central rank conclusions.

0100-CODE-CONFIG — Released settings partly clarify attack budgets and differ in other places from paper descriptions — Limit: Processed-example counts are not automatically counts of distinct examples, nor proof of the actual publication settings.

Mathematical counterevidence: Eq4 explicitly linearizes the inner maximization; its closed-form optimizer of the linearized problem is correct. The audit does not misrepresent it as an exact maximizer of arbitrary nonlinear losses.
Mathematical counterevidence: Eq6 is explicitly a first-order Taylor approximation and Eq8 a finite-difference approximation. These local relations are retained.

Mathematical counterevidence: The conditional min-max formulation requires a relearning objective counteracting the forget objective and a bounded weight-perturbation threat set; it can remain a useful robust surrogate.
Mathematical counterevidence: AlgorithmA1 intentionally bypasses higher-order derivatives. In the scalar counterexample v is locally constant, so this bypass does not remove the counterexample.
Mathematical counterevidence: The analysis does not demonstrate diminished empirical UE/UT, failure of all smoothing, or ineffective unlearning. Empirical score verification is separate.

Mathematical counterevidence: Even a valid local directional-curvature reduction would not itself be a certificate against unrestricted fine-tuning or every attack; the paper's measured attack results remain empirical.

proposition.claim:
The paper states that solving problem(5) drives convergence to a stationary point, which consequently reduces curvature in the sense ||Hv||_2 ->0, with H the original forget-loss Hessian and v its normalized gradient.

Main text p9 says large rho=.1 hinders unlearning effectiveness; AppendixE p15 says it disrupts the process and prevents effective forgetting.

Recorded check: The released gradient penalty has no differentiation path to model parameters

Recorded check: The supplied curvature-regularization command has no dispatch branch; the stored class also detaches its norm

Recorded check: MUSE's named NPO objective uses unnormalized full-vocabulary logits

repair.content:
At rho=.1, pre-attack forget scores remain0.00, while retain utility falls to23.91. Relative to rho=.01, post-attack VerbMem improves from58.38 to52.96 and KnowMem worsens from38.33 to40.52; rho=.01 therefore provides a more favorable reported balance of retain utility and the two robustness metrics.

Keep the norm accumulation as a differentiable tensor and use the intended coefficient; correctness and scalability of a complete repaired training path would require additional verification.
